1. Short title.--This Act

Act, 1934-

Amendment of sections 20A, 20B, and 20C of Act I of 1878

[THE OPIUM (SIND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1934
[THE OPIUM (SIND
AMENDMENT) ACT, 1934.]
SIND ACT No. XI OF
1934*
[*[For Statement of
Objects and Reasons see B. G. G., 1934, Pt. V, pp. 104-105 ; and for
Proceedings in Council, see Bombay Legislative Council Debates, 1934, Vol. XL.]]
[24th October, 1934]
An Act further to
amend the Opium Act, 1878, in its application to the *[Province
of Sind].
2. Amendment of sections 20A,
20B, and 20C of Act I of 1878.---In section 20 of the Opium Act, 1878, in
its application to the *[Province of Sind], hereinafter
called the said Act, for the words "not below the rank of Inspector, and
every officer of the department of Excise not below the rank of Assistant
Inspector" the following shall be substituted, namely, I of 1878 :-
***[and
Excise in Sind, not below the rank of Dafedar.]
*[Subs. by the Sind Laws (Adaptation,
Revision, Repeal and Declaration) Ordinance, 1955 (Sind 5 of 1955), s. 3(i)(a)
(w. e. f. 30th May 1951), or "Presidency of Bombay".]
**[Subs. ibid, s. 3(i) (w. e. f. 30th May
1951), for "Bombay".]
***[Subs. ibid, s. 7. Sch. III, for
"and excise in Sind, not below the rank of Jamadar or Dafedar, every
officer of the Department of Salt, in the Presidency of Bombay except Sind, not
below the rank of Inspector, every Officer of the Department of Excise, in the
Presidency of Bombay, except Sind, not below the rank, of Sub-Inspector".]

3. Amendment of sections 20A,
20B, and 20C of Act I of 1878.---In sections 20A, 20B, and 20C of the said
Act, the words "of the department of Salt and Excise or the Customs
department" shall be omitted.
